operations.title: Closed finite impartial-game record
operations.purpose: Read declared normal-play DAG structure without interpreting model labels as agents.

operations.title: Start-reachable game positions
operations.purpose: Enumerate all positions reachable by a legal move sequence from the supplied start.

operations.title: Terminal positions and mover loss
operations.purpose: Keep zero-option positions distinct from winning positions under normal play.

operations.title: Canonical acyclic dependency order
operations.purpose: Find the lexicographically first valid topological order of the supplied move graph.

operations.title: Strictly decreasing termination rank
operations.purpose: Compute the longest remaining play length at every position.

operations.title: Sprague-Grundy values by minimum exclusion
operations.purpose: Assign each position the least nonnegative value absent from its option values.

operations.title: Full option-value and mex certificate
operations.purpose: Retain duplicate-valued moves, distinct option values and every excluded lower value.

operations.title: Normal-play P and N classification
operations.purpose: Classify a position by recursively winning or losing play, not by observed psychology.

operations.title: Every move to a losing position
operations.purpose: Preserve all winning options rather than claiming a single required move.

operations.title: Deterministic finite winning-move selector
operations.purpose: Choose the least-index winning option with explicit losing and terminal refusal states.

operations.title: Disjunctive-sum Grundy value
operations.purpose: Compare the recursively specified product game with component XOR.

operations.title: Exact disjunctive-sum move graph
operations.purpose: Permit a move in exactly one component and preserve every Cartesian state.

operations.title: Product-game normal-play outcome
operations.purpose: Determine mover winning status in the complete finite product game.

operations.title: All winning component-coordinate moves
operations.purpose: Retain coordinate labels and every move to a losing product position.

operations.title: Product mex and component-XOR certificate
operations.purpose: Check every product-state value against the product option mex and component XOR.

operations.title: Bounded Nim comparison contexts
operations.purpose: Compare losing status against each supplied bounded Nim heap context.

operations.title: Complete terminal-play length census
operations.purpose: Count full terminating plays by length and retain the declared horizon truncation.

operations.title: As-if optimal finite play trace
operations.purpose: Represent one deterministic two-player model trace without claiming autonomous agents.

operations.title: Missing real-world game-to-system evidence
operations.purpose: Keep role labels separate from real empirical, participant and production evidence.

operations.title: External authority and Stage 20 reservation
operations.purpose: Refuse to derive rights, deployment or competent authority from synthetic game labels.
